tweet.text:
pstack 0.15.0 is here! this release contains mainly token usage improvements (between 3 to 11% savings depending on how many skills are loaded by pstack in your session), removing some stray semicolons and emdashes so pstack skills aren't a bad influence, and lots of mannered prose removals (thanks Anthropic for the guide!), along with 2 new principles:

• attack the premise: inspired by @VictorTaelin's recent experience with agents never questioning the premise
• test behavior, not implementation: helps reduce the number of useless tests agents write

if you use /poteto-mode these principles should just be loaded automatically when needed, but you can always invoke on demand as well by autocompleting /principle-... 

https://x.ai/bot/plugin/9717366
